# REAPER API reference

[Developer guide](development.md) | [中文开发指南](development.zh-CN.md) | [Host API](host-api.md)

Catalogue: REAPER **7.80**, **730** standard C/Lua APIs.

All calls use `await reaper.FunctionName(...)`. Signatures below are members of the `ReaWebAPI` TypeScript interface. Return labels preserve the official Lua order. Single results are scalars, multiple results are arrays, and void resolves to `undefined`.

参数及返回顺序遵循 Lua。`?` 表示可选参数，可省略或传 `null`，中间留空须保留参数位置。对象使用句柄，MIDI 字节使用 `Uint8Array`，音频数组在调用完成后回写。

This is the versioned JavaScript contract, not a copy of the full Cockos manual. Each entry links to official parameter-key, flag, unit and behavioral documentation. Those online pages may describe a newer REAPER version. See the [conversion and lifetime rules](development.md#calling-conventions).
